title: Ryanair signs five-year Google Cloud deal, expands use of AI in airline operations
title_zh: 瑞安航空签署为期五年的谷歌云协议，扩大人工智能在航空公司运营中的使用
summary: Ryanair said on Wednesday it would deploy Google's Gemini AI tools and DeepMind models ‌across its operations under a new five-year cloud partnership, using ‌the technology to help manage crew scheduling and make operational decisions.
summary_zh: 瑞安航空周三表示，根据一项新的五年云合作伙伴关系，将在其运营中部署谷歌的 Gemini AI 工具和 DeepMind 模型，利用该技术帮助管理机组人员调度并做出运营决策。

title: Quantinuum Posts First Earnings Since IPO; Strikes Oracle Quantum Deal
title_zh: Quantinuum 公布首次公开募股以来的首次盈利；罢工甲骨文量子交易
summary: Quantinuum reports higher-than-expected revenue and issues an upbeat annual outlook, though the stock barely budges.
summary_zh: Quantinuum 报告的收入高于预期，并发布了乐观的年度前景，但该股几乎没有变化。

title: Intel Just Increased Its Stock Offering to $20B. Why That’s Good News for ASML.
title_zh: 英特尔刚刚将其股票发行额提高至 20B 美元。为什么这对 ASML 来说是个好消息。
summary: Intel stock was down after it said it plans to issue 210.5 million shares at a price of $95 a share but ASML was gaining.
summary_zh: 英特尔表示计划以每股 95 美元的价格发行 2.105 亿股股票，随后该公司股价下跌，但 ASML 却在上涨。

title: Financial Giants Jump Amid Nvidia AI Funding Deal; 1 Eyes Breakout
title_zh: 金融巨头在英伟达人工智能融资交易中跃升； 1 眼睛突破
summary: Nvidia will work with six leading investment companies, including Apollo Global Management, to secure massive new funding for artificial intelligence infrastructure. APO stock jumped near a buy point on Tuesday, extending Monday's rally along with the other financial stocks.
summary_zh: 英伟达将与包括阿波罗全球管理公司在内的六家领先投资公司合作，为人工智能基础设施获得大量新资金。 APO 股票周二跃升至接近买入点，延续了周一与其他金融股的涨势。
